The primary biological variable is the interaction state (binding) between the lncRNA SGOL1-AS1 and proteins in nuclear lysates, using a sense bait versus an antisense control bait. While the paper discusses CRISPRi and ASO knockdown, those were used for RNA-seq and phenotypic assays, not the mass spectrometry experiment.
